packages.name: Lyo.Email
packages.tagline: SMTP email through MailKit. `EmailService` implements `IEmailService`.

packages.name: Lyo.Email.Models
packages.tagline: Shared models, options, error codes, and event arguments for the `Lyo.Email` SMTP service.

packages.name: Lyo.Email.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL schema and `EmailDbContext` for logging emails sent by `Lyo.Email`. This package does not subscribe to `EmailService` events. Consumers map and insert rows themselves.

packages.name: Lyo.Email.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor (MudBlazor) workbench for sending email through an injected `IEmailService`.

packages.name: Lyo.MessageQueue
packages.tagline: `IMqService` is the queue and exchange contract. Schedulers, workers, and gateways compile against one interface and swap `Lyo.MessageQueue.*` brokers behind it.

packages.name: Lyo.MessageQueue.RabbitMq
packages.tagline: `IMqService` implementation (`RabbitMqService`) on `RabbitMQ.Client`. Also registered as `IRabbitMqService` for exchanges and other RabbitMQ-only methods.

packages.name: Lyo.MessageQueue.RabbitMq.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor components for RabbitMQ exchanges, bindings, and broker workbenches.

packages.name: Lyo.MessageQueue.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor components for provider-neutral message queue dashboards and workbenches.

packages.name: Lyo.Sms
packages.tagline: SMS contracts and shared send pipeline. Providers (`Lyo.Sms.Twilio`, and others) implement `SmsServiceBase`.

packages.name: Lyo.Sms.Models
packages.tagline: Shared types for `Lyo.Sms`: payloads, paging, events, normalization, and base options. This package does not send SMS. Implementations live in provider packages (`Lyo.Sms.Twilio`, and others).

packages.name: Lyo.Sms.Postgres
packages.tagline: EF Core PostgreSQL store for outbound SMS logs (`SmsLogEntity`). This package does not send SMS. It wires `SmsDbContext` so workers or gateways can persist send outcomes.

packages.name: Lyo.Sms.Twilio
packages.tagline: Twilio SMS and MMS through `Lyo.Sms`. `TwilioSmsService` implements `ISmsService`.

packages.name: Lyo.Sms.Twilio.Postgres
packages.tagline: EF Core PostgreSQL store for Twilio SMS traces: `TwilioSmsDbContext` and `TwilioSmsLogEntity`.

packages.name: Lyo.Sms.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor (MudBlazor) workbench for an injected `ISmsService`. Uses MudBlazor and snackbar helpers from `Lyo.Web.Components`.

packages.name: Lyo.Stt
packages.tagline: Speech-to-text contract for Lyo. Ships `ISttService`, `SttServiceBase`, request/result/options/event records, and metric name constants. No provider packages ship in this repo.

packages.name: Lyo.Translation
packages.tagline: **Archetype B (capability).** Providers (`Lyo.Translation.Google`, `Lyo.Translation.Aws`) stay under `Communication/Translation/`, not `Integration/`. See package layout.

packages.name: Lyo.Translation.Aws
packages.tagline: Amazon Translate implementation of `ITranslationService`. Translates text, runs bounded bulk translation, infers language via a Translate call, and probes connectivity with `ListLanguages`.

packages.name: Lyo.Translation.Google
packages.tagline: Google Cloud Translation v2 implementation of `ITranslationService`. `GoogleTranslationService` extends `TranslationServiceBase` and calls the REST API over HTTP.

packages.name: Lyo.Translation.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor (MudBlazor) workbench for the configured `Lyo.Translation` implementation.

packages.name: Lyo.Tts
packages.tagline: Contracts and shared TTS behavior: provider-agnostic interfaces, a non-generic facade, and a base service with bulk synthesis, metrics, and lifecycle events.

packages.name: Lyo.Tts.AwsPolly
packages.tagline: Amazon Polly TTS. `AwsPollyTtsService` extends `TtsServiceBase<AwsPollyTtsRequest>` with voice selection, output formats, bulk synthesis, metrics, and DI helpers.

packages.name: Lyo.Tts.AwsPolly.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor (MudBlazor) workbench for trying `Lyo.Tts.AwsPolly` from a host app.

packages.name: Lyo.Tts.Models
packages.tagline: Shared TTS requests, results, options, and event payloads. Provider packages reference this instead of each other.

packages.name: Lyo.Tts.Typecast
packages.tagline: Typecast TTS via `Lyo.Typecast.Client`. `TypecastTtsService` synthesizes audio through `TypecastClient`, can load the voice catalog for validation (`LoadVoicesAsync`), and uses the bulk pipeline and Typecast-namespaced metrics from `Lyo.Tts`.

packages.name: Lyo.Tts.Typecast.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor (MudBlazor) workbench for trying `Lyo.Tts.Typecast` from a host app.

packages.name: Lyo.Tts.WindowsSpeech
packages.tagline: Windows SAPI text-to-speech. `WindowsSpeechTtsService` uses the built-in Speech API.

packages.name: Lyo.Audit
packages.tagline: Audit trail library with two records: `AuditChange` (entity change tracking) and `AuditEvent` (events to log).

packages.name: Lyo.Audit.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL implementation of Lyo.Audit using Entity Framework Core. Persists `AuditChange` and `AuditEvent` records to PostgreSQL with JSONB columns for dictionary data.

packages.name: Lyo.Benchmark
packages.tagline: Benchmark-only helpers shared by every `*.Benchmarks` executable. The BenchmarkDotNet analogue of `Lyo.Testing`.

packages.name: Lyo.Benchmark.Models
packages.tagline: Models and builders for the Lyo benchmark report schema (`lyo.bench/v1`).

packages.name: Lyo.Cache
packages.tagline: Local `ICacheService` plus typed byte payload methods. Serialize once, store framed bytes, optionally compress or encrypt on .NET 10+.

packages.name: Lyo.Cache.Fusion
packages.tagline: `FusionCacheService` adapts `ZiggyCreatures.FusionCache` to `ICacheService` so `Lyo.Api`, workers, and feature modules can swap in-memory `Lyo.Cache` for Fusion plus an optional Redis backplane without rewriting call sites.

packages.name: Lyo.ChangeTracker
packages.tagline: Generic entity change history built around `Lyo.EntityReference.Models.EntityRef`. Record property-level changes for any entity type without coupling the tracker to a specific aggregate.

packages.name: Lyo.ChangeTracker.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL implementation of `Lyo.ChangeTracker`. Persists entity-scoped change history using `Lyo.EntityReference.Models.EntityRef` for both the target entity and the optional actor.

packages.name: Lyo.Common
packages.tagline: Shared primitives: ID generators, file/MIME/language/HTTP/file-size metadata, geometry, secure RNG, typed extensions, and shared `System.Text.Json` options.

packages.name: Lyo.DateAndTime
packages.tagline: Date, time, US timezone conversion, day-of-week scheduling, and US holiday metadata. Static and thread-safe. No mutable shared state.

packages.name: Lyo.Diagnostic
packages.tagline: Stack trace decoding, exception classification, breadcrumb trails, an in-memory error inbox, sanitisation, and structured logging.

packages.name: Lyo.Diagnostic.AspNetCore
packages.tagline: ASP.NET Core integration for `Lyo.Diagnostic`. Scoped breadcrumb trails per request and exception recording to the in-memory error inbox plus structured logging, without replacing existing problem-details middleware.

packages.name: Lyo.Diagnostic.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor (Server / Interactive) workbench for analyzing and triaging .NET stack traces and exception payloads with `Lyo.Diagnostic`.

packages.name: Lyo.Diff
packages.tagline: Side-by-side comparison for human-readable text and object graphs.

packages.name: Lyo.EntityReference.Models
packages.tagline: Typed pair of logical entity kind (`EntityType`) and identifier string (`EntityId`), plus helpers for composite keys, JSON, opaque tokens, validation, and domain row shapes.

packages.name: Lyo.EntityReference.Postgres
packages.tagline: Entity Framework Core building blocks for relation rows (subject/actor associations) and source link rows (import provenance) on PostgreSQL.

packages.name: Lyo.Exceptions
packages.tagline: Exception types and argument validation helpers used by Lyo packages.

packages.name: Lyo.Geolocation
packages.tagline: Provider-agnostic geospatial operations and persistence contracts.

packages.name: Lyo.Geolocation.Models
packages.tagline: Neutral data contracts for `Lyo.Geolocation` and `Lyo.Geolocation.Postgres`.

packages.name: Lyo.Geolocation.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL persistence for canonical geolocation data using Entity Framework Core.

packages.name: Lyo.Health
packages.tagline: Interface for services that report their own health. Implement `IHealth`. There is no central health service.

packages.name: Lyo.Lock
packages.tagline: Key-based exclusive locks and keyed semaphores (bounded concurrency per key), plus in-memory implementations for a single process.

packages.name: Lyo.Lock.Redis
packages.tagline: Distributed `ILockService` on Redis via StackExchange.Redis. Use this when multiple app instances must exclude each other on the same logical key.

packages.name: Lyo.Mathematics
packages.tagline: C# contracts for the Lyo math stack: physical quantities as structs, 2D/3D vectors and small matrices, typed inputs/results for formulas, and a small registry for discoverability.

packages.name: Lyo.Metrics
packages.tagline: Thread-safe counters, gauges, histograms, timings, errors, and events, with in-memory, OpenTelemetry, and null implementations.

packages.name: Lyo.Metrics.OpenTelemetry
packages.tagline: OpenTelemetry implementation of `IMetrics` for exporting metrics to OpenTelemetry-compatible backends.

packages.name: Lyo.Metrics.Statistics
packages.tagline: Statistical analysis extensions for `Lyo.Metrics` histograms. Provides percentile / quartile / moving-average / anomaly-detection helpers on top of the metrics primitives in `Lyo.Metrics`.

packages.name: Lyo.Notification
packages.tagline: In-process publish/subscribe for small domain events. Not durable, not distributed, and not ordered across machines. Only useful when every publisher and handler lives in the same process.

packages.name: Lyo.PackageMetadata
packages.tagline: Multi-ecosystem `PackageMetadata` rows, `PackageMetadataRegistration`, `IPackageMetadataStore`, and `PackageArtifactDigest` helpers for correlating stack-trace namespaces with persisted catalog data.

packages.name: Lyo.PackageMetadata.Postgres
packages.tagline: EF Core persistence for `Lyo.PackageMetadata.IPackageMetadataStore`.

packages.name: Lyo.People.Models
packages.tagline: `Person`, contact, employment, identification, and relationship records for the people domain.

packages.name: Lyo.People.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL persistence for Lyo.People.Models using Entity Framework Core.

packages.name: Lyo.Privacy
packages.tagline: Redacts emails, phones, Luhn card numbers, IBAN, secrets, IDs, URLs, IPs, and street lines in free text, JSON, and XML.

packages.name: Lyo.Privacy.AspNetCore
packages.tagline: ASP.NET Core DI integration for `Lyo.Privacy`: registers `ITextRedactor` / `IStructuredRedactor`, binds `PrivacyRedactorOptions` from configuration, and supports keyed per-tenant or per-feature…

packages.name: Lyo.Privacy.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor (Server / Interactive) workbench components for `Lyo.Privacy`. Lets operators preview, compare, and tune redaction policies without round-tripping through a host config edit.

packages.name: Lyo.Resilience
packages.tagline: A thin wrapper around Polly for resilience pipelines with configuration-from-appsettings support and built-in logging.

packages.name: Lyo.Result
packages.tagline: `Result` / `Result<T>` with `Error` graphs, builders, bulk/paged envelopes, and `Task` composition. Separate from `Lyo.Common` `Result`.

packages.name: Lyo.Schedule.Models
packages.tagline: DTO-only assembly that describes a schedule. Used by `Lyo.Scheduler`, `Lyo.Job.Postgres`, and any consumer that needs a transport-friendly representation of "when does this run".

packages.name: Lyo.Schedule.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor component(s) for building and previewing `Lyo.Schedule.Models.ScheduleDefinition` values interactively.

packages.name: Lyo.Scheduler
packages.tagline: In-process scheduler service for executing actions at scheduled times. Supports **SetTimes**, **Interval**, **OneShot**, and **Cron** schedules (5- or 6-field expressions) with logging, metrics, and…

packages.name: Lyo.Scheduler.Cache
packages.tagline: Cache-backed `ISchedulerStateStore` for `Lyo.Scheduler`. Persists each schedule's `LastRunUtc` / `NextRunUtc` / state markers through `Lyo.Cache` so cron/interval/one-shot schedules survive process…

packages.name: Lyo.Scientific
packages.tagline: Scientific domain models, reference datasets, SI-oriented unit helpers, and formula discovery built on `Lyo.Mathematics`.

packages.name: Lyo.Streams
packages.tagline: `TeeStream`, `CountingStream`, `ProgressStream`, `ConcatenatedStream`, and related stream wrappers. Incremental hashing lives in `Lyo.Hashing` (`HashingStream`).

packages.name: Lyo.Testing
packages.tagline: xUnit v3 helpers: fluent `Should*` assertions, exception and collection helpers, polling assertions, and an `ITestOutputHelper` logger.

packages.name: Lyo.Testing.Containers
packages.tagline: xUnit v3 fixtures around Testcontainers for PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ.

packages.name: Lyo.TextEncoding
packages.tagline: Binary codecs (Base64 / Base64Url / Hex) and charset encode/decode/convert with CodePages, detection, PEM/MIME, and injectable services.

packages.name: Lyo.Validation
packages.tagline: C# validators, fluent rule builders, validation attributes, and `WhereClause` schemas that return `Lyo.Result.Result<T>` failures.

packages.name: Lyo.Validation.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL persistence for `ValidationSchema` documents (WhereClause JSONB) via `IValidationSchemaStore`.

packages.name: Lyo.Webhook
packages.tagline: Inbound webhook verification for ASP.NET Core: raw body and headers, HMAC helpers, `MapWebhook().Verify().Handle()`, and `Lyo.Metrics` timings.

packages.name: Lyo.Webhook.Twilio
packages.tagline: Twilio webhook signature validation for `Lyo.Webhook`. Compares `X-Twilio-Signature` to an HMAC-SHA1 (Base64) of the public request URL plus sorted key+value form parameters.

packages.name: Lyo.Barcode
packages.tagline: Barcode generation and decoding contracts: IBarcodeService, request and options models, and BarcodeBuilder.

packages.name: Lyo.Barcode.Native
packages.tagline: IBarcodeService implementation for Lyo.Barcode. No third-party barcode generator.

packages.name: Lyo.Barcode.TestWorkbench.Web.Components
packages.tagline: MudBlazor page wrapper that hosts <BarcodeWorkbench /> from Lyo.Barcode.Web.Components inside a MudContainer for the Lyo gateway test harness.

packages.name: Lyo.Barcode.Web.Components
packages.tagline: MudBlazor components that call IBarcodeService from Lyo.Barcode.

packages.name: Lyo.Compression
packages.tagline: Compress and decompress bytes, strings, streams, and files through ICompressionService. One default codec, plus ICompressionResolver for per-algorithm dispatch.

packages.name: Lyo.Compression.BZip2
packages.tagline: BZip2 compression addon for `Lyo.Compression`. Registers a BZip2 `ICompressorFactory`.

packages.name: Lyo.Compression.Lz4
packages.tagline: LZ4 compression addon for `Lyo.Compression`. Registers an `LZ4` `ICompressorFactory` backed by `EasyCompressor.LZ4`.

packages.name: Lyo.Compression.Lzma
packages.tagline: LZMA compression addon for `Lyo.Compression`. Registers an LZMA `ICompressorFactory`.

packages.name: Lyo.Compression.Snappier
packages.tagline: Snappy compression addon for `Lyo.Compression`. Registers a Snappier `ICompressorFactory`.

packages.name: Lyo.Compression.Xz
packages.tagline: XZ / LZMA2 compression addon for `Lyo.Compression`. Registers an XZ `ICompressorFactory`.

packages.name: Lyo.Compression.Zstd
packages.tagline: Zstandard compression addon for `Lyo.Compression`. Registers a Zstd `ICompressorFactory`.

packages.name: Lyo.Csv
packages.tagline: Owned CSV stack implementing Lyo.Csv.Models. CsvService composes a CsvWriter and CsvReader over an internal tokenizer/writer with typed binders. No third-party CSV library.

packages.name: Lyo.Csv.Models
packages.tagline: Interfaces and value types for the Lyo CSV stack. Lyo.Csv implements this contract so consumers can depend on ICsvService, ICsvReader, and ICsvWriter without the implementation package.

packages.name: Lyo.DataTable
packages.tagline: Empty package placeholder reserving the `Lyo.DataTable` name. The runtime types (`DataTable`, `DataTableRow`, `DataTableBuilder`, cell types, HTML renderer) all live in `Lyo.DataTable.Models`.

packages.name: Lyo.DataTable.Models
packages.tagline: Mutable in-memory data table with sparse columns, thin cells, an optional format map, fluent builders, and an HTML renderer.

packages.name: Lyo.FFmpeg
packages.tagline: Wraps the ffmpeg, ffprobe, and ffplay CLIs (via CliWrap) behind IAudioPlayer, IAudioProber, and IAudioConverter from Lyo.FFmpeg.Models.

packages.name: Lyo.FFmpeg.Models
packages.tagline: Contracts and models for Lyo.FFmpeg: IAudioPlayer, IAudioProber, IAudioConverter, AudioConversionRequest, AudioConversionOptions, AudioProbeResult, and FFmpegOptions.

packages.name: Lyo.FileMetadataStore
packages.tagline: File identity without bytes. Canonical Guid file identifiers and metadata, not blob I/O.

packages.name: Lyo.FileMetadataStore.Postgres
packages.tagline: Postgres IFileMetadataStore plus adjunct stores used by richer file pipelines.

packages.name: Lyo.FileMetadataStore.Sqlite
packages.tagline: SQLite IFileMetadataStore using Entity Framework Core. Same store and adjunct services as Lyo.FileMetadataStore.Postgres, for embedded, offline-first, and local-dev hosts.

packages.name: Lyo.FileStorage
packages.tagline: Save, stream-save, read, delete, and metadata for files. Optional compression (Lyo.Compression), two-key encryption (Lyo.Encryption), duplicate hashing, access policies, malware scans, audit hooks, multipart uploads (IMultipartUploadService), and presigned/direct-upload/copy on cloud backends.

packages.name: Lyo.FileStorage.AzureBlob
packages.tagline: Azure Blob Storage implementation of IFileStorageService using Azure.Storage.Blobs.

packages.name: Lyo.FileStorage.Ftp
packages.tagline: FTP-backed IFileStorageService via Lyo.Ftp.Client.

packages.name: Lyo.FileStorage.S3
packages.tagline: S3-compatible storage for Lyo.FileStorage (AWS S3, Backblaze B2, MinIO, and others) via AWSSDK.S3.

packages.name: Lyo.FileStorage.Sftp
packages.tagline: SFTP-backed IFileStorageService via Lyo.Sftp.Client.

packages.name: Lyo.FileStorage.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor Server / Interactive UI for Lyo.FileStorage. Tree/grids and dialogs for file metadata, expected storage keys, download access links, and DEK migrate/rotate.

packages.name: Lyo.FileSystemWatcher
packages.tagline: Snapshot-based file watcher for .NET. Detects creates, deletes, changes, moves, and renames with debounce and SHA256 hashing.

packages.name: Lyo.Formatter
packages.tagline: SmartFormat.NET templating for user-defined strings: named placeholders, lists, pluralization, and culture-aware formatting.

packages.name: Lyo.Formatter.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor pair for live SmartFormat editing: a debounced template box and an annotated preview that color-links `{keys}` to replacements. Works on WASM.

packages.name: Lyo.Ftp.Client
packages.tagline: Pooled FluentFTP client with PathHelpers jail, logging, and Lyo.Metrics. Prefer `*Async`.

packages.name: Lyo.IO.Temp
packages.tagline: Create and manage temporary files and directories with sessions, naming strategies, and overflow handling.

packages.name: Lyo.IO.Temp.Ftp
packages.tagline: FTP-backed IIOTempStorageProvider for Lyo.IO.Temp.

packages.name: Lyo.IO.Temp.Sftp
packages.tagline: SFTP-backed IIOTempStorageProvider for Lyo.IO.Temp.

packages.name: Lyo.Images
packages.tagline: Raster image processing for .NET using SixLabors.ImageSharp.

packages.name: Lyo.Images.Ocr
packages.tagline: OCR contracts for Lyo: `IOcrEngine`, request/response models, Y-up pixel bounding boxes (aligned with `BoundingBox2D`), coordinate helpers, and shared options.

packages.name: Lyo.Images.Ocr.Tesseract
packages.tagline: Tesseract implementation of `IOcrEngine` from `Lyo.Images.Ocr`. Calls are serialized with an internal lock because native Tesseract instances are not safely concurrent.

packages.name: Lyo.Images.OpenCv
packages.tagline: OpenCV helpers for .NET via OpenCvSharp4. Separate from higher-level pipelines (e.g. comic overlay) so hosts pull native OpenCV only where needed.

packages.name: Lyo.Images.Skia
packages.tagline: SkiaSharp `IImageService` from `Lyo.Images`: resize, crop, rotate, watermark, convert, thumbnails, compression, metadata, palette, batch.

packages.name: Lyo.Images.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor / MudBlazor workbenches for `Lyo.Images`: `IImageService` ops and a spritesheet animator/extractor on `ISpriteSheetExportService`.

packages.name: Lyo.Pdf
packages.tagline: PdfPig-backed reading and PDFsharp-backed editing for `Lyo.Pdf.Models`. `PdfService` is the entry point; it returns disposable `IPdfReader` instances for read/extract workflows and `IPdfWriter`…

packages.name: Lyo.Pdf.Models
packages.tagline: Interfaces and value types for the Lyo PDF stack. Defines the contracts implemented by `Lyo.Pdf` so consumers can depend on `IPdfService`, `IPdfReader`, `IPdfWriter`, and `ITextExtractor` without…

packages.name: Lyo.Pdf.Ocr
packages.tagline: Renders a PDF page to PNG via `Lyo.Pdf.Rendering`, runs `IOcrEngine`, then maps OCR pixel boxes back into PDF points.

packages.name: Lyo.Pdf.Rendering
packages.tagline: Rasterizes PDF pages to PNG via PDFtoImage (PDFium + Skia; `bblanchon.PDFium` native packages). Targets `net10.0`.

packages.name: Lyo.Pdf.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor / MudBlazor PDF workbenches: HTML to PDF, annotation, and `LyoPdfAnnotator` for drawing bounding-box regions that emit `PdfBoundingBox`.

packages.name: Lyo.Postgres
packages.tagline: Shared PostgreSQL migration plumbing for Lyo libraries that ship their own EF Core schema (Audit, Email, ChangeTracker, EntityReference, etc.).

packages.name: Lyo.QRCode
packages.tagline: QR code generation and reading for Lyo: `IQRCodeService`, `QRCodeBuilder`, ISO Model 2 encoding in-box (`BuiltInQRCodeService`), optional QRCoder adapter.

packages.name: Lyo.QRCode.QRCoder
packages.tagline: QRCoder implementation of `IQRCodeService` from `Lyo.QRCode`. Use this for JPEG / Bitmap on Windows, or QRCoder's renderers.

packages.name: Lyo.QRCode.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor / MudBlazor components for QR code generation and preview.

packages.name: Lyo.Query
packages.tagline: WhereClause AST → LINQ on IQueryable: filter, multi-key sort, in-memory match/explain, with ICache-backed compiled predicates.

packages.name: Lyo.Query.Models
packages.tagline: Filter / sort / projection DTOs and fluent builders (`WhereClause`, QueryConcrete / QueryProject / root Query) shared by Lyo.Query and Lyo.Api.

packages.name: Lyo.Query.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor / MudBlazor components for editing and running `Lyo.Query.Models` requests against any Lyo.Api host.

packages.name: Lyo.Sftp.Client
packages.tagline: Pooled SSH.NET SFTP client with PathHelpers jail, logging, and Lyo.Metrics. Prefer `*Async`.

packages.name: Lyo.Sqlite
packages.tagline: Shared SQLite migration plumbing for Lyo libraries that ship their own EF Core schema.

packages.name: Lyo.Xlsx
packages.tagline: Implementation of `Lyo.Xlsx.Models`. `XlsxService` composes an `XlsxWriter` (streaming `DocumentFormat.OpenXml` writer) and an `XlsxReader` (ExcelDataReader / ClosedXML) to read and write XLSX…

packages.name: Lyo.Xlsx.Models
packages.tagline: Interfaces and value types for the Lyo XLSX stack. Defines the contract implemented by `Lyo.Xlsx` so consumers can depend on `IXlsxService` / `IXlsxReader` / `IXlsxWriter` without pulling in ClosedXML…

packages.name: Lyo.Comic
packages.tagline: Domain contracts for a serialized fiction catalog: series (`ComicSeries`, `ComicAlternateTitle`), hierarchy (`ComicVolume`, `ComicChapter`, `ComicPage`), cast (`ComicCharacter`), `ComicSeriesQuery`, `ComicType`/`ComicStatus`, and `IComicStore`.

packages.name: Lyo.Comic.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL + EF Core implementation of `Lyo.Comic.IComicStore` (`PostgresComicStore`) via `ComicDbContext` and `PostgresComicOptions`.

packages.name: Lyo.Comic.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor components for browsing, previewing, and reading comic series. Search panel, result grids and lists, browse cards, and a MangaFire-style tap-to-navigate reader.

packages.name: Lyo.Comment
packages.tagline: Abstractions for threaded, reactable comments on any entity. Each comment has a **subject**, an **actor**, optional `ReplyToCommentId`, and cached like/dislike counters.

packages.name: Lyo.Comment.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL implementation of `Lyo.Comment` using Entity Framework Core. Persists comments to `comment.comment` and reactions to `comment.comment_reaction`.

packages.name: Lyo.Config
packages.tagline: Typed, definition-driven configuration for per-entity values (a Discord guild, a tenant). The abstract API lives here. PostgreSQL persistence is in `Lyo.Config.Postgres`.

packages.name: Lyo.Config.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL + EF Core implementation of `Lyo.Config.IConfigStore` for typed configuration definitions and per-entity bindings.

packages.name: Lyo.Config.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor / MudBlazor dashboard for Lyo.Config. Add ConfigManagement to a host page for definitions, resolved bindings, and revision revert against IConfigStore.

packages.name: Lyo.ContactUs
packages.tagline: Contact-form submission contracts. `IContactUsService` and `ContactUsServiceBase` handle validation, error-code mapping, and logging. Storage lives in sibling packages.

packages.name: Lyo.ContactUs.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL + EF Core implementation of `Lyo.ContactUs.IContactUsService` (`PostgresContactUsService`) via `ContactUsDbContext` and `PostgresContactUsOptions`.

packages.name: Lyo.Favorite
packages.tagline: Abstractions for "X favorited Y" relationships across any two entities. The API accepts `EntityRef` at the boundary.

packages.name: Lyo.Favorite.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL implementation of `Lyo.Favorite` using Entity Framework Core. Persists favorites to the `favorite.favorite` table (`PostgresFavoriteOptions.Schema = "favorite"`).

packages.name: Lyo.HomeInventory
packages.tagline: Contract for household inventory: large purchases (electronics, appliances) with warranty tracking, kitchen consumables across pantries / freezers, and garage bin locations.

packages.name: Lyo.HomeInventory.Postgres
packages.tagline: EF Core implementation of `IHomeInventoryStore` backed by PostgreSQL.

packages.name: Lyo.Note
packages.tagline: Abstractions for notes attached to entities. Each note has a **subject** (what it is about) and an **actor** (who wrote it), expressed as `EntityRef`.

packages.name: Lyo.Note.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL implementation of `Lyo.Note` using Entity Framework Core. Persists notes to the `note.note` table (`PostgresNoteOptions.Schema = "note"`) and ships migrations.

packages.name: Lyo.Profanity
packages.tagline: File-based profanity filter. Detects and replaces profane words. Multiple languages, regex patterns, plain word lists, and configurable replacement strategies.

packages.name: Lyo.Rating
packages.tagline: Abstractions for rating and reviewing entities, plus like/dislike reactions on those ratings.

packages.name: Lyo.Rating.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL implementation of `Lyo.Rating` using Entity Framework Core. Persists ratings to `rating.rating` and reactions to `rating.rating_reaction`.

packages.name: Lyo.ShortUrl
packages.tagline: URL shortening contracts: `IShortUrlService`, `ShortUrlServiceBase` for validation / metrics / error-code mapping, a default `ShortUrlService` that generates short codes (no storage), `UrlShortenBuilder`, and shorten / expand / statistics DTOs.

packages.name: Lyo.ShortUrl.Postgres
packages.tagline: EF Core schema and DbContext registration for a PostgreSQL-backed short-URL store.

packages.name: Lyo.Tag
packages.tagline: Abstractions for tagging entities. Tags key off an `EntityRef` (what is tagged) and an optional second `EntityRef` (who applied the tag).

packages.name: Lyo.Tag.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL implementation of `Lyo.Tag` using Entity Framework Core. Persists tags to the `tag.tag` table (`PostgresTagOptions.Schema = "tag"`) and ships migrations.

packages.name: Lyo.Api
packages.tagline: Minimal-API library that maps EF Core entities to REST CRUD. `ApiEndpointBuilder` emits Query, Get, Create, Update, Patch, Delete, Upsert, bulk variants, and optional export.

packages.name: Lyo.Api.Client
packages.tagline: HTTP client for Lyo minimal APIs: JSON in/out, gzip/brotli/deflate, query-string encoding for GET DTOs, file upload helpers, and `System.Text.Json` parity with server options when you wire them.

packages.name: Lyo.Api.Export
packages.tagline: Optional export for Lyo.Api. Registers the Export CRUD endpoint and `IExportService<TContext>`.

packages.name: Lyo.Api.FileStorage
packages.tagline: HTTP endpoints for Lyo file storage. Hosts map BuildFileStorageApi after registering a keyed IFileStorageService stack.

packages.name: Lyo.Api.FileStorage.Models
packages.tagline: HTTP request and response DTOs for the file-storage API. No dependency on Lyo.FileStorage.

packages.name: Lyo.Api.Models
packages.tagline: Shared HTTP contract models for Lyo minimal APIs and their clients. Distinct from `Lyo.Query.Models` (filter trees + projection DTOs).

packages.name: Lyo.Api.Reporting
packages.tagline: Authenticated HTTP endpoints for Lyo Reporting. Postgres stays service-only (`ReportService` + EF). This package owns `BuildReportingGroup`.

packages.name: Lyo.Api.Tests.Host
packages.tagline: Reference ASP.NET Core minimal-API host used by `Lyo.Api.Tests` and other integration tests as a `WebApplicationFactory<Program>` target.

packages.name: Lyo.Discord.Bot
packages.tagline: Library (not an executable) that runs a DSharpPlus Discord bot and upserts guild data into your Lyo API (`Lyo.Discord.Client` to PostgreSQL-backed `Discord/*` endpoints).

packages.name: Lyo.Discord.Client
packages.tagline: Typed HTTP client for the Discord REST endpoints exposed by `Lyo.Api` (the `Discord/*` group registered by `Lyo.Discord.Postgres`).

packages.name: Lyo.Discord.Models
packages.tagline: Wire-level DTOs and shared constants for the Discord integration. Used by `Lyo.Discord.Client` (typed HTTP client) and `Lyo.Discord.Postgres` (API host + persistence) so request and response shapes match.

packages.name: Lyo.Discord.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL persistence and `Lyo.Api` endpoint mappings for Discord entities. Schema name is fixed to `discord` (`PostgresDiscordOptions.Schema`).

packages.name: Lyo.Endato.Client
packages.tagline: Typed HTTP client for the Endato data-enrichment REST API.

packages.name: Lyo.Endato.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL schema and EF Core context for caching Endato Person Search (PS) and Contact Enrichment (CE) responses. Schema name is `endato`.

packages.name: Lyo.Espn.Fantasy.Football.Client
packages.tagline: Typed read-only client for the ESPN fantasy football v3 API (`lm-api-reads.fantasy.espn.com/apis/v3/games/ffl/`).

packages.name: Lyo.Google.Geolocation.Client
packages.tagline: Google Maps REST client and `IGeolocationService` implementation.

packages.name: Lyo.Job.Alerts
packages.tagline: Hosted `JobAlertConsumer` that subscribes to the `job.notifications.alert` routing key on the `job.events` exchange, deserializes `JobAlertEvent` payloads, and dispatches them through `INotificationPublisher` and/or an optional HTTP webhook.

packages.name: Lyo.Job.Client
packages.tagline: Typed HTTP client for the Lyo Job API. Wraps `IApiClient` with run lifecycle methods (`StartAsync`, `LogAsync`, `FinishAsync`, `RequeueAsync`) and worker-instance endpoints from `Lyo.Job.Models.Constants.Rest.Job`.

packages.name: Lyo.Job.Models
packages.tagline: Shared DTOs, builders, enums, metrics constants, distributed-tracing helpers, and message-queue contracts for the Lyo job-management subsystem.

packages.name: Lyo.Job.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL persistence and minimal-API host for the Lyo job-management subsystem.

packages.name: Lyo.Job.Scheduler
packages.tagline: Hosted `JobScheduler` that polls the Job API for enabled definitions, evaluates schedules (misfire catch-up, blackout calendars, per-schedule time zones), and creates job runs via `IApiClient`.

packages.name: Lyo.Job.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor / MudBlazor dashboard for the Lyo job stack. Add `JobManagement` to a host page for Statistics, Definitions, Schedules, Runs (progress and SLA breach), worker registry, and workflow views.

packages.name: Lyo.Job.Worker
packages.tagline: Worker SDK for the Lyo job system. Subclass `JobWorkerBase` and implement `ExecuteAsync(IJobWorkerContext)`. The base class consumes the priority-enabled worker-type queue.

packages.name: Lyo.Reporting.Client
packages.tagline: Typed HTTP client for the Lyo Reporting API (`netstandard2.0;net10.0`).

packages.name: Lyo.Reporting.Models
packages.tagline: Composition models, fluent builders, API contracts, and generation hooks for Lyo Reporting.

packages.name: Lyo.Reporting.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL schema (`reporting`), EF migrations, CSV/XLSX/JSON renderers, `ReportService` generation pipeline, and `ReportRetentionService` cleanup.

packages.name: Lyo.Reporting.Web
packages.tagline: Blazor `ReportViewer`, business document templates, and an `IReportRenderer` that emits HTML and PDF.

packages.name: Lyo.Reporting.Web.Components
packages.tagline: MudBlazor ops UI for Lyo Reporting: browse definitions, run reports, and view/download generations.

packages.name: Lyo.Typecast.Client
packages.tagline: Typecast API client for text-to-speech and voice management. `TypecastClient` extends `Lyo.Api.Client.ApiClient`, configures the `X-API-KEY` header from `TypecastClientOptions`, and exposes two…

packages.name: Lyo.Web.Automation
packages.tagline: Shared browser automation models: element locators, JSON automation plans, session abstraction, and plan runners. No Playwright or Selenium types.

packages.name: Lyo.Web.Automation.Playwright
packages.tagline: Playwright implementation of the `Lyo.Web.Automation` abstractions: launches Chromium / Firefox / WebKit, manages session-scoped browser contexts, and matches the Selenium helpers.

packages.name: Lyo.Web.Automation.Selenium
packages.tagline: Selenium WebDriver implementation of the `Lyo.Web.Automation` abstractions: browser launch (Chrome / Edge / Firefox / Safari + Selenium Grid), session isolation, polling, tabs, frames, and plans.

packages.name: Lyo.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Blazor / MudBlazor components for Lyo web UI: data grid, query builder, change-tracking form, file upload, rich-text editor, JSON editor, text-diff viewer, and identifier workbench.

packages.name: Lyo.Web.Components.Export
packages.tagline: Export menu items for Lyo data grids. Reference this package (plus optional format packages) and add items to `BulkExportControls`.

packages.name: Lyo.Web.WebRenderer
packages.tagline: Server-side rendering of Razor components and HTML→PDF conversion. Razor rendering uses `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web.HtmlRenderer`; PDF conversion is driven by **PuppeteerSharp** against a…

packages.name: Lyo.Config.Api
packages.tagline: HTTP host for central app configuration backed by PostgreSQL and `Lyo.Config`.

packages.name: Lyo.Config.Api.Client
packages.tagline: Typed HTTP client for `Lyo.Config.Api`. Conditional app-config reads with `If-None-Match` / `?version` polling, optional `X-Api-Key`, and one DI extension.

packages.name: Lyo.Config.Api.Host
packages.tagline: Standalone ASP.NET host for `Lyo.Config.Api`.

packages.name: Lyo.Config.Api.Hosting
packages.tagline: Wires `IConfigApiClient` (`Lyo.Config.Api.Client`) into `Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection` and `Microsoft.Extensions.Options`. A `BackgroundService` polls a shared `ResolvedConfigRecord` ledger.

packages.name: Lyo.Config.Api.Models
packages.tagline: Contracts for the Config HTTP API: `ConfigResolveOutcome`, `ConfigResolveConditionalResult`, and `HttpStatusDescriptor`.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication
packages.tagline: Server-side authentication services for Lyo. Two coexisting bearer formats behind a single contract.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication.AspNetCore
packages.tagline: ASP.NET Core integration for `Lyo.Authentication`. Three schemes coexist behind a single dispatcher.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication.Client
packages.tagline: Consumer-side runtime for the Lyo BFF auth flow. Plugs a web host, typically a Blazor Server gateway or a server-rendered API consumer, into a Lyo authentication API without ever exposing tokens to the browser.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication.Google
packages.tagline: Google profile for `Lyo.Authentication.OpenIdConnect`. Registers `https://accounts.google.com` as a confidential OIDC client in the BFF login flow.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication.Keycloak
packages.tagline: Keycloak profile for `Lyo.Authentication.OpenIdConnect`. Wires one or more Keycloak realms as confidential OIDC clients in the BFF login flow.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication.Models
packages.tagline: Wire-shape data for `Lyo.Authentication`. The half of the auth stack that's safe to ship to anyone, including Blazor WebAssembly clients.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication.OpenIdConnect
packages.tagline: OpenID Connect client base for Lyo. The Lyo API is the OIDC confidential client (BFF pattern). The frontend never sees the IdP and never receives tokens by URL fragment.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication.Postgres
packages.tagline: PostgreSQL persistence for `Lyo.Authentication`. Replaces the in-memory stores from the base lib with EF Core-backed implementations of `IApiTokenStore`, `IUserStore`, and `IExternalIdentityStore`.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication.Web.Components
packages.tagline: Host-agnostic Razor / MudBlazor components for Lyo authentication. Ships the Login, Auth Debug, and Profile pages plus the abstractions that the Server and Wasm host adapters implement.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication.Web.Components.Server
packages.tagline: Blazor Server host adapter for `Lyo.Authentication.Web.Components`. Plugs the shared login / debug / profile pages into the BFF-cookie auth runtime in `Lyo.Authentication.Client`.

packages.name: Lyo.Authentication.Web.Components.Wasm
packages.tagline: Blazor WebAssembly host adapter for `Lyo.Authentication.Web.Components`. Implements the same login / debug / profile pages over a pure-browser auth flow. No consumer-side server, no HttpOnly cookie.

packages.name: Lyo.ContentThreatScan
packages.tagline: Heuristic scanning and numeric disposition scoring for readable text payloads: scripts, markup, suspicious SQL-ish patterns.

packages.name: Lyo.ContentThreatScan.Intel
packages.tagline: Optional `DefaultContentThreatReputationPipeline` for Malware Bazaar, VirusTotal, and `clamd` INSTREAM (TCP).

packages.name: Lyo.Encryption
packages.tagline: Authenticated encryption for .NET. AEAD, RSA hybrids, and envelope (two-key) flows with optional Lyo.KeyStore lookup.

packages.name: Lyo.Encryption.AesCcm
packages.tagline: AES-CCM authenticated encryption addon for `Lyo.Encryption`. Provides `AesCcmEncryptionService` (BouncyCastle-backed on all targets) and matching DI extensions.

packages.name: Lyo.Encryption.AesSiv
packages.tagline: AES-SIV (RFC 5297) deterministic authenticated encryption addon for `Lyo.Encryption`. Provides `AesSivEncryptionService` backed by `Dorssel.Security.Cryptography.AesExtra` and matching DI extensions.

packages.name: Lyo.Encryption.XChaCha20Poly1305
packages.tagline: XChaCha20-Poly1305 (24-byte nonce, 32-byte key) authenticated-encryption addon for `Lyo.Encryption`.

packages.name: Lyo.Hashing
packages.tagline: Digests (SHA-256/384/512), optional MD5 for non-security fingerprints only, non-cryptographic checksums (CRC-32/CRC-32C/CRC-64/Adler-32), hexadecimal encoding (`HexEncoding`), incremental hashing (`HashingStream`), sparse file fingerprints (`SparseFileFingerprinter`), and injectable `IHashingService` / `HashingService`.

packages.name: Lyo.KeyStore
packages.tagline: Key encryption key (KEK) storage and rotation contracts for `Lyo.Encryption`.

packages.name: Lyo.KeyStore.Aws
packages.tagline: `AwsKeyStore` takes an `IAmazonSecretsManager` client and a secret-name prefix. It implements `Lyo.KeyStore.IKeyStore` and `Lyo.KeyStore.IKeyInventoryStore`, so admin UIs and key-rotation jobs can encrypt against it and list `keyId`s and versions.

packages.name: Lyo.KeyStore.Web.Components
packages.tagline: In-process Blazor workbench for IKeyStore. Lists key ids and versions, adds from a string, rotates, and sets current. No HTTP, no raw key bytes.

packages.name: Lyo.Cli
packages.tagline: Installable `lyo` command-line tool for encryption, encoding, compression, hashing, IDs, query build/exec, and CSV/XLSX.

packages.name: Lyo.Preview
packages.tagline: Cross-platform preview in the system default browser. `BrowserPreview` starts an `HttpListener` on `127.0.0.1` (random free port), serves one byte buffer per call, opens the URL, and drops the entry after the browser fetches it.

packages.name: Lyo.TestApi
packages.tagline: Minimal-API host that backs `Lyo.TestGateway` and `Lyo.TestConsole`. Wires Lyo Postgres stores, the RabbitMQ job system, S3 file storage with two-key encryption, and the file-storage workbench endpoints.

packages.name: Lyo.TestConsole
packages.tagline: Scratch host for exercising Lyo services from a long-lived `Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting` process.

packages.name: Lyo.TestGateway
packages.tagline: Interactive Blazor Server workbench for the Lyo platform. About 30 routed test pages (cache, locks, file storage, PDF, and more) plus a thin proxy so each page can hit a remote API or in-process services.

packages.name: Lyo.Tools.Postgres
packages.tagline: Spectre.Console TUI for running and rolling back EF Core migrations against Lyo Postgres `DbContext`s, plus a couple of Bogus-powered seeders.
